articles.summary: Chicago, August 20, 2024 – GoHealth, Inc. (GoHealth) (NASDAQ: GOCO), a leading health insurance marketplace and Medicare-focused digital health company, today announced the conclusion of the Alliance of Licensed Medicare Insurance Agencies (ALMIA) Medicare Conference.
articles.title: GoHealth, Inc. Hosts Medicare Conference, Convening Industry Leaders to Discuss the Latest Developments Ahead of the 2025 Annual Enrollment Period
